To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of the Grounded Theory Approach and the computer in media research is a promising and effective way to gain a better understanding of the complex phenomena in the field of media.
the computer can be a valuable tool for the researcher, especially in the phases of data collection, coding, and data management.

1) Grounded Theory offers an integrated approach to qualitative research; 2) the computer is a powerful and flexible research tool for the analysis of qualitative data; 3) the Grounded Theory method can be used for qualitative analysis with the help of the computer; and 4) the Grounded theory method is a useful approach for the analysis of media content.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to make qualitative analysis more efficient and effective by means of computers.
the use of the Grounded Theory approach in media research.

the use of computer software in the process of analysis, the use of the Grounded Theory Approach in the field of media research, the use of Grounded Theory in the analysis of qualitative data, the use of computer-assisted qualitative data analysis software (CAQDAS) in the analysis of media content, the use of qualitative data analysis in the field of communication, and the use of computer programs in the analysis of textual data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Grounded Theory and computers are a good fit.
the computer can be used as a tool in all phases of the analysis, but that its use should be carefully considered and planned in each phase.
Grounded Theory is an ideal approach to use with the computer, but that the computer is not an ideal tool to use in Grounded Theory research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
computers are not a panacea for all the problems of qualitative data analysis but they can be very useful for the researcher in the process of analysis.
Grounded Theory is a method of inquiry that is based on the systematic collection and analysis of qualitative data.
the computer is a tool to support the Grounded Theory researcher in the analysis process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of the qualitative software package ATLAS.ti is a useful aid in the process of qualitative research.
computers can facilitate the process of qualitative analysis in a variety of ways and can be used to enhance the quality of the research.
